desc: 44185 on a train formed of mainly ex-DB stock is seen at the Black Sea port and resort of Burgas on 26 October 2018. The train is 8612, 14:30 Burgas to Sofia via Plovdiv.

title: File:26.09.12 Karnobat 46234 (8047699822).jpg
desc:
Bulgaria Trip Day Three.
Karnobat is a major junction station where the lines to the Black Sea ports of Burgas and Varna split. As a result some trains from Sofia via Plovdiv split and join here at Karnobat.
